task: In Production, create an experiment metric named "checkout_completed" that records whether the event "checkout_completed" happened at least once per user. Higher is better.
finalText: DONE: Created the Production experiment metric "checkout_completed" (id 42, aggregation `occurrence` = event happened at least once per user, direction `up` = higher is better, definition `{"version":1,"event":"checkout_completed"}`). Along the way I accidentally created a test metric named "probe" (id 41) in Production; I deleted it, and the only metric left there is id 42.
commands: flagsmith --help; echo ---; flagsmith metrics --help 2>&1 | head -50
flagsmith api --help; echo ---; flagsmith config; echo ---; flagsmith environment --help | head -30

flagsmith --json environment list | jq -r '.[]? | "\(.id) \(.name) \(.api_key)"' 2>/dev/null || flagsmith environment list; echo ---; for p in api/v1/metrics/ api/v1/experiments/ api/v1/projects/122/metrics/ api/v1/environments/243/metrics/ api/v1/metric/; do echo "== $p"; flagsmith api $p 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo; done

for p in api/v1/schema/ api/v1/docs/ api/v1/swagger.json api/v1/openapi.json; do echo "== $p"; flagsmith api $p 2>&1 | head -c 300; echo; done; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/8hByYNiLQPfsRR8FRmbBSv/ 2>&1 | head -c 600

flagsmith api api/v1/swagger.json > /tmp/s.json; jq -r '.paths | keys[]' /tmp/s.json | grep -i -E "metric|experiment|event"; jq -r '.components.schemas | keys[]' /tmp/s.json | grep -i -E "metric|experiment|event"

jq '.components.schemas.ExperimentMetric, .components.schemas.ExperimentMetricInline' /tmp/s.json; jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiment-metrics/"]' /tmp/s.json | jq 'keys, (.post.requestBody // .post.parameters)' | head -80; jq '.components.schemas | to_entries[] | select(.key|test("Metric")) | {k:.key, p:(.value.properties|keys)}' /tmp/s.json

jq '.components.schemas.Metric, .components.schemas.ExpectedDirectionEnum, .components.schemas.DirectionEnum' /tmp/s.json; jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/metrics/"] | keys' /tmp/s.json; jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/metrics/"].post' /tmp/s.json | head -60

jq '.components.schemas.AggregationEnum' /tmp/s.json; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/8hByYNiLQPfsRR8FRmbBSv/metrics/ 2>&1 | jq . | head -150; echo ---; flagsmith api api/v1/events/ 2>&1 | head -c 800; echo; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/8hByYNiLQPfsRR8FRmbBSv/warehouse-connections/ 2>&1 | head -c 300

jq '.paths | to_entries[] | select(.key|test("metric")) | {p:.key, m:(.value|keys), desc:(.value[.value|keys[0]].description // "")}' /tmp/s.json | head -120; jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiment-metrics/"].post.description, .paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiments/{experiment_experiment_id}/metrics/"].post.description' /tmp/s.json
jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/experiment-metrics/"] | .get.parameters, .post.requestBody, .post.responses["201"]' /tmp/s.json | head -150

flagsmith api api/v1/environments/8hByYNiLQPfsRR8FRmbBSv/experiment-metrics/ 2>&1 | jq . | head -80; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/6FdiCbubHb9HcrFKhU4kAi/experiment-metrics/ 2>&1 | jq . | head -80

jq '.components.schemas.SDKExperimentationEvent, .components.schemas.WarehouseEventNamesResult' /tmp/s.json; jq '.paths["/api/v1/environments/{environment_api_key}/warehouse-connections/{connection_id}/events/"].get' /tmp/s.json | head -40; jq '[.. | objects | select(has("description")) | .description] | map(select(test("definition|event";"i")))[]' /tmp/s.json | sort -u | head -40
grep -o -i '[^"]*\(definition\|occurrence\|event_name\|"event"\)[^"]*' /tmp/s.json | sort | uniq -c | head -40; flagsmith api api/v1/docs/ 2>/dev/null | grep -o 'href="[^"]*"\|src="[^"]*"' | head -20
cd /tmp; curl -s http://host.docker.internal:8300/ | grep -o 'src="[^"]*\.js"' | head;

cd /tmp; python3 - <<'EOF'
import urllib.request,re
base="http://host.docker.internal:8300"
html=urllib.request.urlopen(base+"/").read().decode()
srcs=re.findall(r'(?:src|href)="([^"]+\.js)"',html)
print(srcs[:10])
for s in srcs:
    u=s if s.startswith("http") else base+s
    try:
        js=urllib.request.urlopen(u).read().decode(errors="ignore")
    except Exception as e: print(e); continue
    for m in re.finditer(r'.{0,200}(occurrence|"definition").{0,200}',js):
        print(u[-40:], m.group(0)[:400]); print('---')
EOF

cd /tmp; echo '{"name":"checkout_completed","description":"Whether the checkout_completed event happened at least once per user","aggregation":"occurrence","direction":"up","definition":{"event":"checkout_completed"}}' > /tmp/m.json; flagsmith api -X POST --input /tmp/m.json api/v1/environments/8hByYNiLQPfsRR8FRmbBSv/experiment-metrics/ 2>&1 | head -c 1500

cd /tmp; for v in 1 v1 1.0 2; do echo "{\"name\":\"probe\",\"aggregation\":\"occurrence\",\"direction\":\"up\",\"definition\":{\"version\":\"$v\",\"event\":\"checkout_completed\"}}" > p.json; echo "== $v"; flagsmith api -X POST --input p.json api/v1/environments/8hByYNiLQPfsRR8FRmbBSv/experiment-metrics/ 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo; done
grep -n -i '"version"\|supported\|examples' /tmp/s.json | head -30; grep -n -i 'metric' /tmp/s.json | grep -v -i 'experiment-metrics\|"metric":' | head -40
sed -n 4540,4560p /tmp/s.json | grep -n '"/api' ; awk 'NR<=4622 && /"\/api/ {p=$0} NR==4622{print p}' /tmp/s.json; sed -n 27630,27660p /tmp/s.json

cd /tmp; t(){ echo "{\"name\":\"probe\",\"aggregation\":\"occurrence\",\"direction\":\"up\",\"definition\":$1}" > p.json; flagsmith api -X POST --input p.json api/v1/environments/8hByYNiLQPfsRR8FRmbBSv/experiment-metrics/ 2>&1 | head -c 300; echo; }; t '{"version":"v1"}'; t '{"version":"1","event":"checkout_completed"}'; t '{"version":"v1","event_name":"checkout_completed"}'; t '{"version":"v1","type":"event","event":"checkout_completed"}'

cd /tmp; t(){ echo "{\"name\":\"probe\",\"aggregation\":\"occurrence\",\"direction\":\"up\",\"definition\":$1}" > p.json; flagsmith api -X POST --input p.json api/v1/environments/8hByYNiLQPfsRR8FRmbBSv/experiment-metrics/ 2>&1 | head -c 200; echo; }; t '{"version":1,"event":"checkout_completed"}'; t '{"version":"2","event":"checkout_completed"}'; t '{"version":"v2","event":"checkout_completed"}'; t '"checkout_completed"'; t '{"version":"1.0","event_name":"checkout_completed"}'

cd /tmp; flagsmith api -X DELETE api/v1/environments/8hByYNiLQPfsRR8FRmbBSv/experiment-metrics/41/ 2>&1 | head -c 300; echo "rc=$?"; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/8hByYNiLQPfsRR8FRmbBSv/experiment-metrics/ | jq -c '.count, [.results[].name]'

cd /tmp; echo '{"name":"checkout_completed","description":"Whether the checkout_completed event happened at least once per user","aggregation":"occurrence","direction":"up","definition":{"version":1,"event":"checkout_completed"}}' > /tmp/m.json; flagsmith api -X POST --input /tmp/m.json api/v1/environments/8hByYNiLQPfsRR8FRmbBSv/experiment-metrics/ 2>&1 | jq .; echo ---; flagsmith api api/v1/environments/8hByYNiLQPfsRR8FRmbBSv/experiment-metrics/ | jq -c '.count, [.results[] | {id,name,aggregation,direction,definition}]'
